# Machine Learning For Kids

> > An interactive platform teaching machine learning and Python programming to students grades 6-11 through hands-on projects, courses, and summer classes.

Machine Learning For Kids (ML4K) is an educational platform created by Dale Lane that makes machine learning accessible to young learners. The site offers structured courses using real datasets from Kaggle and other sources, combined with practical projects and seasonal classes in Lexington, MA.

## Key Topics

- Machine Learning
- Python Programming
- Data Science
- Classification & Clustering
- Supervised Learning
- Project-Based Learning
- Kaggle Datasets
- STEM Education
- Scratch Coding
- Data Analysis
- Beginner Courses
- Kids Education
- Orange Data Mining
- AI Training
- ChatGPT

## Getting Started

- [Machine Learning For Kids Homepage](https://www.ml4k.org): Main entry point for the Machine Learning For Kids platform by Dale Lane
- [Summer Classes](https://www.ml4k.org/summer-classes): Summer ML classes for grades 6-11 in Lexington MA
- [Class Schedule](https://www.ml4k.org/class-schedule): Fall term schedule for Python and AI coding classes

## Student Projects & Portfolio

- [Student Projects Showcase](https://www.ml4k.org/projects): Showcase of student ML projects including classification and clustering applications

## Course Materials

- [Course P.1 Class 9 - Classification with Titanic Dataset](https://www.ml4k.org/p1-9): Beginner course using Titanic dataset for classification learning
- [Course P.2 Class 1 - Mobile Phone Price Classification](https://www.ml4k.org/p2-1): Mobile phone price classification course using Kaggle dataset
- [Course M.2 Class 4 - Student Grades Prediction](https://www.ml4k.org/m2-4): Student grades prediction using UCL ML Repository dataset
- [Course M.2 Class 5 - NBA Player Stats Analysis](https://www.ml4k.org/m2-5): NBA player stats data analysis course material from Kaggle
